values.d:h2h_pending: Rows marked n/m (BioCLIP 2 features + linear probe; DINOv2 features + linear probe) are filled by the baselines run (card L6-e) and appear on the next rebuild.
values.d:fix_status: The numbers in this report were recomputed after that fix (cards L2-f, L3-d and L6-d), so the DINO half of every embedding now holds real DINOv2-large features.
values.d:knn_note: With the DINO half repaired, the kNN row is the cleanest test of whether the second encoder adds information, since kNN uses the whole vector without any training.
values.d:sets_note: but they are almost always a single species. This is not a success of the sets; it is a property of the threshold rule when the model is already more than 90% accurate (Section 7)
values.d:selective_note: below the target: the post-cutoff test photos are harder than the pre-cutoff calibration photos, so a threshold tuned on calibration is too permissive on test

values.d:e2e_note: 4.0% of the answers were flagged "not in catalogue". This run used the repaired DINO loader, so live and cached vectors agree; the remaining rejections come from the open-set gate itself (Section 6.6).
